crossRefs.note: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.
The great court around had three courses of cut stone, and a course of cedar beams; like the inner court of Yahweh’s…

translations.web: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with bronze.
translations.bsb: He made the courtyard of the priests and the large court with its doors, and he overlaid the doors with bronze.
translations.kjv: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
translations.asv: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
